entities.name: Oloro
entities.description: Legendary giant soldier who manipulates life and death and guards the secret of eternal life on a mist-shrouded island.

events.summary: Oloro guards what he believes is the secret to eternal life on his remote island.
events.quote: He believes to be in possession of the secret to eternal life and, as such, guards it jealously on his remote, mist-shrouded island.
